1.001.001  tapaḥsvādhyāyanirataṃ tapasvī vāgvidāṃ varam
1.001.001 nāradaṃ paripapraccha vālmīkirmunipuṃgavam
1.001.002  ko nvasmin sāmprataṃ loke guṇavān kaśca vīryavān
1.001.002 dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca satyavākyo dṛḍhavrataḥ
1.001.003  cāritreṇa ca ko yuktaḥ sarvabhūteṣu ko hitaḥ
1.001.003 vidvān kaḥ kaḥ samarthaśca kaścaikapriyadarśanaḥ
1.001.004  ātmavān ko jitakrodho matimān ko'nasūyakaḥ

1.001.008 niyatātmā mahāvīryo dyutimān dhṛtimān vaśī

1.001.009 vipulāṃso mahābāhuḥ kambugrīvo mahāhanuḥ

1.001.012  dharmajñaḥ satyasaṃdhaśca prajānāṃ ca hite rataḥ

1.001.013  rakṣitā jīvalokasya dharmasya parirakṣitā

1.001.015  sarvadābhigataḥ sadbhiḥ samudra iva sindhubhiḥ
1.001.015 āryaḥ sarvasamaścaiva sadaikapriyadarśanaḥ
1.001.016  sa ca sarvaguṇopetaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ

1.001.017  viṣṇunā sadṛśo vīrye somavatpriyadarśanaḥ
1.001.017 kālāgnisadṛśaḥ krodhe kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ
1.001.018  dhanadena samastyāge satye dharma ivāparaḥ
1.001.018 tamevaṃguṇasaṃpannaṃ rāmaṃ satyaparākramam
1.001.019  jyeṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaguṇairyuktaṃ priyaṃ daśarathaḥ sutam
1.001.019 yauvarājyena saṃyoktumaicchatprītyā mahīpatiḥ

1.001.020 pūrvaṃ dattavarā devī varamenamayācata
1.001.020  vivāsanaṃ ca rāmasya bharatasyābhiṣecanam

1.001.022  sa jagāma vanaṃ vīraḥ pratijñāmanupālayan

1.001.024 sītāpyanugatā rāmaṃ śaśinaṃ rohiṇī yathā
1.001.025  paurairanugato dūraṃ pitrā daśarathena ca

1.001.026  te vanena vanaṃ gatvā nadīstīrtvā bahūdakāḥ
1.001.026 citrakūṭamanuprāpya bharadvājasya śāsanāt
1.001.027  ramyamāvasathaṃ kṛtvā ramamāṇā vane trayaḥ
1.001.027 devagandharvasaṃkāśāstatra te nyavasan sukham
1.001.028  citrakūṭaṃ gate rāme putraśokāturastadā
1.001.028 rājā daśarathaḥ svargaṃ jagāma vilapan sutam
1.001.029  mṛte tu tasmin bharato vasiṣṭhapramukhairdvijaiḥ
1.001.029 niyujyamāno rājyāya naicchadrājyaṃ mahābalaḥ
1.001.029  sa jagāma vanaṃ vīro rāmapādaprasādakaḥ
1.001.030  pāduke cāsya rājyāya nyāsaṃ dattvā punaḥ punaḥ
1.001.030 nivartayāmāsa tato bharataṃ bharatāgrajaḥ
1.001.031  sa kāmamanavāpyaiva rāmapādāvupaspṛśan
1.001.031 nandigrāme'karodrājyaṃ rāmāgamanakāṅkṣayā
1.001.032  rāmastu punarālakṣya nāgarasya janasya ca
1.001.032 tatrāgamanamekāgre daṇḍakān praviveśa ha
1.001.033  virādhaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatvā śarabhaṅgaṃ dadarśa ha
1.001.033 sutīkṣṇaṃ cāpyagastyaṃ ca agastya bhrātaraṃ tathā
1.001.034  agastyavacanāccaiva jagrāhaindraṃ śarāsanam
1.001.034 khaḍgaṃ ca paramaprītastūṇī cākṣayasāyakau
1.001.035  vasatastasya rāmasya vane vanacaraiḥ saha
1.001.035 ṛṣayo'bhyāgaman sarve vadhāyāsurarakṣasām
1.001.036  tena tatraiva vasatā janasthānanivāsinī

1.001.037  tataḥ śūrpaṇakhāvākyādudyuktān sarvarākṣasān
1.001.037 kharaṃ triśirasaṃ caiva dūṣaṇaṃ caiva rākṣasaṃ
1.001.038  nijaghāna raṇe rāmasteṣāṃ caiva padānugān
1.001.038 rakṣasāṃ nihatānyāsan sahasrāṇi caturdaśa
1.001.039  tato jñātivadhaṃ śrutvā rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
1.001.039 sahāyaṃ varayāmāsa mārīcaṃ nāma rākṣasaṃ
1.001.040  vāryamāṇaḥ subahuśo mārīcena sa rāvaṇaḥ
1.001.040 na virodho balavatā kṣamo rāvaṇa tena te
1.001.041  anādṛtya tu tadvākyaṃ rāvaṇaḥ kālacoditaḥ
1.001.041 jagāma sahamarīcastasyāśramapadaṃ tadā
1.001.042  tena māyāvinā dūramapavāhya nṛpātmajau
1.001.042 jahāra bhāryāṃ rāmasya gṛdhraṃ hatvā jaṭāyuṣam
1.001.043  gṛdhraṃ ca nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛtāṃ śrutvā ca maithilīm
1.001.043 rāghavaḥ śokasaṃtapto vilalāpākulendriyaḥ
1.001.044  tatastenaiva śokena gṛdhraṃ dagdhvā jaṭāyuṣam
1.001.044 mārgamāṇo vane sītāṃ rākṣasaṃ saṃdadarśa ha
1.001.045  kabandhaṃ nāma rūpeṇa vikṛtaṃ ghoradarśanam
1.001.045 taṃ nihatya mahābāhurdadāha svargataśca saḥ
1.001.046  sa cāsya kathayāmāsa śabarīṃ dharmacāriṇīm
1.001.046 śramaṇīṃ dharmanipuṇāmabhigaccheti rāghava
1.001.046  so'bhyagacchanmahātejāḥ śabarīṃ śatrusūdanaḥ
1.001.047  śabaryā pūjitaḥ samyagrāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
1.001.047 pampātīre hanumatā saṃgato vānareṇa ha
1.001.048  hanumadvacanāccaiva sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ
1.001.048 sugrīvāya ca tatsarvaṃ śaṃsadrāmo mahābalaḥ
1.001.049  tato vānararājena vairānukathanaṃ prati

1.001.049  vālinaśca balaṃ tatra kathayāmāsa vānaraḥ
1.001.050  pratijñātaṃ ca rāmeṇa tadā vālivadhaṃ prati
1.001.050 sugrīvaḥ śaṅkitaścāsīnnityaṃ vīryeṇa rāghave
1.001.051  rāghavaḥ pratyayārthaṃ tu dundubheḥ kāyamuttamam
1.001.051 pādāṅguṣṭhena cikṣepa saṃpūrṇaṃ daśayojanam
1.001.052  bibheda ca punaḥ sālān saptaikena maheṣuṇā
1.001.052 giriṃ rasātalaṃ caiva janayan pratyayaṃ tadā
1.001.053  tataḥ prītamanāstena viśvastaḥ sa mahākapiḥ
1.001.053 kiṣkindhāṃ rāmasahito jagāma ca guhāṃ tadā
1.001.054  tato'garjaddharivaraḥ sugrīvo hemapiṅgalaḥ

1.001.055  tataḥ sugrīvavacanāddhatvā vālinamāhave
1.001.055 sugrīvameva tadrājye rāghavaḥ pratyapādayat
1.001.056  sa ca sarvān samānīya vānarān vānararṣabhaḥ
1.001.056 diśaḥ prasthāpayāmāsa didṛkṣurjanakātmajām
1.001.057  tato gṛdhrasya vacanātsaṃpāterhanumān balī
1.001.057 śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ pupluve lavaṇārṇavam
1.001.058  tatra laṅkāṃ samāsādya purīṃ rāvaṇapālitām

1.001.059  nivedayitvābhijñānaṃ pravṛttiṃ ca nivedya ca
1.001.059 samāśvāsya ca vaidehīṃ mardayāmāsa toraṇam
1.001.060  pañca senāgragān hatvā sapta mantrisutānapi

3.024.001  avaṣṭabdhadhanuṃ rāmaṃ kruddhaṃ ca ripughātinam

3.024.006  tatastaṃ bhīmadhanvānaṃ kruddhāḥ sarve niśācarāḥ

3.024.016  durāvārān durviṣahān kālapāśopamān raṇe

3.024.018  bhittvā rākṣasadehāṃstāṃste śarā rudhirāplutāḥ
3.024.018 antarikṣagatā rejurdīptāgnisamatejasaḥ
3.024.019  asaṃkhyeyāstu rāmasya sāyakāścāpamaṇḍalāt
3.024.019 viniṣpeturatīvogrā rakṣaḥ prāṇāpahāriṇaḥ
3.024.020  tairdhanūṃṣi dhvajāgrāṇi varmāṇi ca śirāṃsi ca

3.024.022  tatsainyaṃ niśitairbāṇairarditaṃ marmabhedibhiḥ

3.024.028  tadbabhūvādbhutaṃ yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam

3.025.001  taddrumāṇāṃ śilānāṃ ca varṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ mahat
3.025.001 pratijagrāha dharmātmā rāghavastīkṣṇasāyakaiḥ
3.025.002  pratigṛhya ca tadvaraṃ nimīlita ivarṣabhaḥ
3.025.002 rāmaḥ krodhaṃ paraṃ bheje vadhārthaṃ sarvarakṣasām
3.025.003  tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭaḥ pradīpta iva tejasā
3.025.003 śarairabhyakiratsainyaṃ sarvataḥ sahadūṣaṇam

3.025.005  veṣṭitaṃ kāñcanaiḥ paṭṭairdevasainyābhimardanam
3.025.005 āyasaiḥ śaṅkubhistīkṣṇaiḥ kīrṇaṃ paravasokṣitām
3.025.006  vajrāśanisamasparśaṃ paragopuradāraṇam

3.025.006  dūṣaṇo'bhyapatadrāmaṃ krūrakarmā niśācaraḥ
3.025.007  tasyābhipatamānasya dūṣaṇasya sa rāghavaḥ
3.025.007 dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ ciccheda sahastābharaṇau bhujau

3.025.011  etasminnantare kruddhāstrayaḥ senāgrayāyinaḥ

3.025.020  tairmuktakeśaiḥ samare patitaiḥ śoṇitokṣitaiḥ

3.027.020 ciccheda rāmaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kharasya samare dhvajam

5.010.001  sa tasya madhye bhavanasya vānaro̭ latāgṛhāṃścitragṛhānniśāgṛhān

5.042.016 na dhanurna ratho nāśvāstatrādṛśyanta neṣavaḥ
5.042.017  sa hatastarasā tena jambumālī mahārathaḥ
5.042.017 papāta nihato bhūmau cūrṇitāṅgavibhūṣaṇaḥ
5.042.018  jambumāliṃ ca nihataṃ kiṃkarāṃśca mahābalān
5.042.018 cukrodha rāvaṇaḥ śrutvā kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ
5.042.019  sa roṣasaṃvartitatāmralocana̭ḥ prahastaputre nihate mahābale
5.042.019 amātyaputrānativīryavikramāṋ samādideśāśu niśācareśvaraḥ
5.043.001  tataste rākṣasendreṇa coditā mantriṇaḥ sutāḥ
5.043.001 niryayurbhavanāttasmātsapta saptārcivarcasaḥ
5.043.002  mahābalaparīvārā dhanuṣmanto mahābalāḥ
5.043.002 kṛtāstrāstravidāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ
5.043.003  hemajālaparikṣiptairdhvajavadbhiḥ patākibhiḥ
5.043.003 toyadasvananirghoṣairvājiyuktairmahārathaiḥ
5.043.004  taptakāñcanacitrāṇi cāpānyamitavikramāḥ
5.043.004 visphārayantaḥ saṃhṛṣṭāstaḍidvanta ivāmbudāḥ
5.043.005  jananyastāstatasteṣāṃ viditvā kiṃkarān hatān
5.043.005 babhūvuḥ śokasaṃbhrāntāḥ sabāndhavasuhṛjjanāḥ
5.043.006  te parasparasaṃgharṣāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ
5.043.006 abhipeturhanūmantaṃ toraṇasthamavasthitam
5.043.007  sṛjanto bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ te rathagarjitaniḥsvanāḥ
5.043.007 vṛṣṭimanta ivāmbhodā vicerurnairṛtarṣabhāḥ
5.043.008  avakīrṇastatastābhirhanūmāñśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ
5.043.008 abhavatsaṃvṛtākāraḥ śailarāḍiva vṛṣṭibhiḥ
5.043.009  sa śarān vañcayāmāsa teṣāmāśucaraḥ kapiḥ
5.043.009 rathavegāṃśca vīrāṇāṃ vicaran vimale'mbare
5.043.010  sa taiḥ krīḍan dhanuṣmadbhirvyomni vīraḥ prakāśate
5.043.010 dhanuṣmadbhiryathā meghairmārutaḥ prabhurambare
5.043.011  sa kṛtvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ trāsayaṃstāṃ mahācamūm
5.043.011 cakāra hanumān vegaṃ teṣu rakṣaḥsu vīryavān
5.043.012  talenābhihanatkāṃścitpādaiḥ kāṃścitparaṃtapaḥ
5.043.012 muṣṭinābhyahanatkāṃścinnakhaiḥ kāṃścidvyadārayat
5.043.013  pramamāthorasā kāṃścidūrubhyāmaparān kapiḥ
5.043.013 ke cittasyaiva nādena tatraiva patitā bhuvi
5.043.014  tatasteṣvavapanneṣu bhūmau nipatiteṣu ca
5.043.014 tatsainyamagamatsarvaṃ diśo daśabhayārditam
5.043.015  vinedurvisvaraṃ nāgā nipeturbhuvi vājinaḥ
5.043.015 bhagnanīḍadhvajacchatrairbhūśca kīrṇābhavadrathaiḥ
5.043.016  sa tān pravṛddhān vinihatya rākṣasāṋ mahābalaścaṇḍaparākramaḥ kapiḥ
5.043.016 yuyutsuranyaiḥ punareva rākṣasais̭ tadeva vīro'bhijagāma toraṇam
5.044.001  hatānmantrisutān buddhvā vānareṇa mahātmanā
5.044.001 rāvaṇaḥ saṃvṛtākāraścakāra matimuttamām
5.044.002  sa virūpākṣayūpākṣau durdharaṃ caiva rākṣasaṃ
5.044.002 praghasaṃ bhāsakarṇaṃ ca pañcasenāgranāyakān
5.044.003  saṃdideśa daśagrīvo vīrānnayaviśāradān
5.044.003 hanūmadgrahaṇe vyagrān vāyuvegasamān yudhi
5.044.004  yāta senāgragāḥ sarve mahābalaparigrahāḥ
5.044.004 savājirathamātaṅgāḥ sa kapiḥ śāsyatāmiti
5.044.005  yattaiśca khalu bhāvyaṃ syāttamāsādya vanālayam
5.044.005 karma cāpi samādheyaṃ deśakālavirodhitam
5.044.006  na hyahaṃ taṃ kapiṃ manye karmaṇā pratitarkayan
5.044.006 sarvathā tanmahadbhūtaṃ mahābalaparigraham
5.044.006  bhavedindreṇa vā sṛṣṭamasmadarthaṃ tapobalāt
5.044.007  sanāgayakṣagandharvā devāsuramaharṣayaḥ
5.044.007 yuṣmābhiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvairmayā saha vinirjitāḥ
5.044.008  tairavaśyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ vyalīkaṃ kiṃ cideva naḥ
5.044.008 tadeva nātra saṃdehaḥ prasahya parigṛhyatām
5.044.009  nāvamanyo bhavadbhiśca hariḥ krūraparākramaḥ
5.044.009 dṛṣṭā hi harayaḥ śīghrā mayā vipulavikramāḥ
5.044.010  vālī ca saha sugrīvo jāmbavāṃśca mahābalaḥ
5.044.010 nīlaḥ senāpatiścaiva ye cānye dvividādayaḥ
5.044.011  naiva teṣāṃ gatirbhīmā na tejo na parākramaḥ
5.044.011 na matirna balotsāho na rūpaparikalpanam
5.044.012  mahatsattvamidaṃ jñeyaṃ kapirūpaṃ vyavasthitam
5.044.012 prayatnaṃ mahadāsthāya kriyatāmasya nigrahaḥ
5.044.013  kāmaṃ lokāstrayaḥ sendrāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ
5.044.013 bhavatāmagrataḥ sthātuṃ na paryāptā raṇājire
5.044.014  tathāpi tu nayajñena jayamākāṅkṣatā raṇe
5.044.014 ātmā rakṣyaḥ prayatnena yuddhasiddhirhi cañcalā
5.044.015  te svāmivacanaṃ sarve pratigṛhya mahaujasaḥ
5.044.015 samutpeturmahāvegā hutāśasamatejasaḥ
5.044.016  rathaiśca mattairnāgaiśca vājibhiśca mahājavaiḥ
5.044.016 śastraiśca vividhaistīkṣṇaiḥ sarvaiścopacitā balaiḥ
5.044.017  tatastaṃ dadṛśurvīrā dīpyamānaṃ mahākapim
5.044.017 raśmimantamivodyantaṃ svatejoraśmimālinam
5.044.018  toraṇasthaṃ mahāvegaṃ mahāsattvaṃ mahābalam
5.044.018 mahāmatiṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābalam
5.044.019  taṃ samīkṣyaiva te sarve dikṣu sarvāsvavasthitāḥ
5.044.019 taistaiḥ praharaṇairbhīmairabhipetustatastataḥ
5.044.020  tasya pañcāyasāstīkṣṇāḥ sitāḥ pītamukhāḥ śarāḥ
5.044.020 śirastyutpalapatrābhā durdhareṇa nipātitāḥ
5.044.021  sa taiḥ pañcabhirāviddhaḥ śaraiḥ śirasi vānaraḥ
5.044.021 utpapāta nadan vyomni diśo daśa vinādayan
5.044.022  tatastu durdharo vīraḥ sarathaḥ sajjakārmukaḥ
5.044.022 kirañśaraśatairnaikairabhipede mahābalaḥ
5.044.023  sa kapirvārayāmāsa taṃ vyomni śaravarṣiṇam
5.044.023 vṛṣṭimantaṃ payodānte payodamiva mārutaḥ
5.044.024  ardyamānastatastena durdhareṇānilātmajaḥ
5.044.024 cakāra ninadaṃ bhūyo vyavardhata ca vegavān
5.044.025  sa dūraṃ sahasotpatya durdharasya rathe hariḥ
5.044.025 nipapāta mahāvego vidyudrāśirgirāviva
5.044.026  tatastaṃ mathitāṣṭāśvaṃ rathaṃ bhagnākṣakūvaram
5.044.026 vihāya nyapatadbhūmau durdharastyaktajīvitaḥ
5.044.027  taṃ virūpākṣayūpākṣau dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṃ bhuvi
5.044.027 saṃjātaroṣau durdharṣāvutpetaturariṃdamau
5.044.028  sa tābhyāṃ sahasotpatya viṣṭhito vimale'mbare
5.044.028 mudgarābhyāṃ mahābāhurvakṣasyabhihataḥ kapiḥ
5.044.029  tayorvegavatorvegaṃ vinihatya mahābalaḥ
5.044.029 nipapāta punarbhūmau suparṇasamavikramaḥ
5.044.030  sa sālavṛkṣamāsādya samutpāṭya ca vānaraḥ
5.044.030 tāvubhau rākṣasau vīrau jaghāna pavanātmajaḥ
5.044.031  tatastāṃstrīn hatāñjñātvā vānareṇa tarasvinā
5.044.031 abhipede mahāvegaḥ prasahya praghaso harim
5.044.032  bhāsakarṇaśca saṃkruddhaḥ śūlamādāya vīryavān
5.044.032 ekataḥ kapiśārdūlaṃ yaśasvinamavasthitau
5.044.033  paṭṭiśena śitāgreṇa praghasaḥ pratyapothayat
5.044.033 bhāsakarṇaśca śūlena rākṣasaḥ kapisattamam
5.044.034  sa tābhyāṃ vikṣatairgātrairasṛgdigdhatanūruhaḥ
5.044.034 abhavadvānaraḥ kruddho bālasūryasamaprabhaḥ
5.044.035  samutpāṭya gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ samṛgavyālapādapam
5.044.035 jaghāna hanumān vīro rākṣasau kapikuñjaraḥ
5.044.036  tatasteṣvavasanneṣu senāpatiṣu pañcasu
5.044.036 balaṃ tadavaśeṣaṃ tu nāśayāmāsa vānaraḥ
5.044.037  aśvairaśvān gajairnāgān yodhairyodhān rathai rathān
5.044.037 sa kapirnāśayāmāsa sahasrākṣa ivāsurān
5.044.038  hatairnāgaiśca turagairbhagnākṣaiśca mahārathaiḥ
5.044.038 hataiśca rākṣasairbhūmī ruddhamārgā samantataḥ
5.044.039  tataḥ kapistān dhvajinīpatīn raṇḙ nihatya vīrān sabalān savāhanān
5.044.039 tadeva vīraḥ parigṛhya toraṇa̭ṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye
5.045.001  senāpatīn pañca sa tu pramāpitāṋ hanūmatā sānucarān savāhanān
5.045.001 samīkṣya rājā samaroddhatonmukha̭ṃ kumāramakṣaṃ
prasamaikṣatākṣatam
5.045.002  sa tasya dṛṣṭyarpaṇasaṃpracodita̭ḥ pratāpavān kāñcanacitrakārmukaḥ
5.045.002 samutpapātātha sadasyudīrito̭ dvijātimukhyairhaviṣeva pāvakaḥ
5.045.003  tato mahadbāladivākaraprabha̭ṃ prataptajāmbūnadajālasaṃtatam
5.045.003 rathāṃ samāsthāya yayau sa vīryavāṋ mahāhariṃ taṃ prati nairṛtarṣabhaḥ
5.045.004  tatastapaḥsaṃgrahasaṃcayārjita̭ṃ prataptajāmbūnadajālaśobhitam
5.045.004 patākinaṃ ratnavibhūṣitadhvaja̭ṃ manojavāṣṭāśvavaraiḥ suyojitam
5.045.005  surāsurādhṛṣyamasaṃgacāriṇa̭ṃ raviprabhaṃ vyomacaraṃ samāhitam
5.045.005 satūṇamaṣṭāsinibaddhabandhura̭ṃ yathākramāveśitaśaktitomaram
5.045.006  virājamānaṃ pratipūrṇavastunā̭ sahemadāmnā śaśisūryavarvasā
5.045.006 divākarābhaṃ rathamāsthitastata̭ḥ sa nirjagāmāmaratulyavikramaḥ
5.045.007  sa pūrayan khaṃ ca mahīṃ ca sācalā̭ṃ turaṃgamataṅgamahārathasvanaiḥ
5.045.007 balaiḥ sametaiḥ sa hi toraṇasthita̭ṃ samarthamāsīnamupāgamatkapim
5.045.008  sa taṃ samāsādya hariṃ harīkṣaṇo̭ yugāntakālāgnimiva prajākṣaye
5.045.008 avasthitaṃ vismitajātasaṃbhrama̭ḥ samaikṣatākṣo bahumānacakṣuṣā
5.045.009  sa tasya vegaṃ ca kapermahātmana̭ḥ parākramaṃ cāriṣu pārhtivātmajaḥ
5.045.009 vicārayan khaṃ ca balaṃ mahābalo̭ himakṣaye sūrya ivābhivardhate
5.045.010  sa jātamanyuḥ prasamīkṣya vikrama̭ṃ sthiraḥ sthitaḥ saṃyati durnivāraṇam
5.045.010 samāhitātmā hanumantamāhavḙ pracodayāmāsa śaraistribhiḥ śitaiḥ
5.045.011  tataḥ kapiṃ taṃ prasamīkṣya garvita̭ṃ jitaśramaṃ śatruparājayorjitam
5.045.011 avaikṣatākṣaḥ samudīrṇamānasa̭ḥ sabāṇapāṇiḥ pragṛhītakārmukaḥ
5.045.012  sa hemaniṣkāṅgadacārukuṇḍala̭ḥ samāsasādāśu parākramaḥ kapim
5.045.012 tayorbabhūvāpratimaḥ samāgama̭ḥ surāsurāṇāmapi saṃbhramapradaḥ
5.045.013  rarāsa bhūmirna tatāpa bhānumāṋ vavau na vāyuḥ pracacāla cācalaḥ
5.045.013 kapeḥ kumārasya ca vīkṣya saṃyuga̭ṃ nanāda ca dyaurudadhiśca cukṣubhe
5.045.014  tataḥ sa vīraḥ sumukhān patatriṇa̭ḥ suvarṇapuṅkhān saviṣānivoragān
5.045.014 samādhisaṃyogavimokṣatattvavic̭ charānatha trīn kapimūrdhnyapātayat
5.045.015  sa taiḥ śarairmūrdhni samaṃ nipātitai̭ḥ kṣarannasṛgdigdhavivṛttalocanaḥ
5.045.015 navoditādityanibhaḥ śarāṃśumāṋ vyarājatāditya ivāṃśumālikaḥ
5.045.016  tataḥ sa piṅgādhipamantrisattama̭ḥ samīkṣya taṃ rājavarātmajaṃ raṇe
5.045.016 udagracitrāyudhacitrakārmuka̭ṃ jaharṣa cāpūryata cāhavonmukhaḥ
5.045.017  sa mandarāgrastha ivāṃśumālī̭ vivṛddhakopo balavīryasaṃyutaḥ
5.045.017 kumāramakṣaṃ sabalaṃ savāhana̭ṃ dadāha netrāgnimarīcibhistadā
5.045.018  tataḥ sa bāṇāsanaśakrakārmuka̭ḥ śarapravarṣo yudhi rākṣasāmbudaḥ
5.045.018 śarānmumocāśu harīśvarācalḙ balāhako vṛṣṭimivācalottame
5.045.019  tataḥ kapistaṃ raṇacaṇḍavikrama̭ṃ vivṛddhatejobalavīryasāyakam
5.045.019 kumāramakṣaṃ prasamīkṣya saṃyugḙ nanāda harṣādghanatulyavikramaḥ
5.045.020  sa bālabhāvādyudhi vīryadarpita̭ḥ pravṛddhamanyuḥ kṣatajopamekṣaṇaḥ
5.045.020 samāsasādāpratimaṃ raṇe kapi̭ṃ gajo mahākūpamivāvṛtaṃ tṛṇaiḥ
5.045.021  sa tena bāṇaiḥ prasabhaṃ nipātitaiś̭ cakāra nādaṃ ghananādaniḥsvanaḥ
5.045.021 samutpapātāśu nabhaḥ sa mārutir̭ bhujoruvikṣepaṇa ghoradarśanaḥ
5.045.022  samutpatantaṃ samabhidravadbalī̭ sa rākṣasānāṃ pravaraḥ pratāpavān
5.045.022 rathī rathaśreṣṭhatamaḥ kirañśarai̭ḥ payodharaḥ śailamivāśmavṛṣṭibhiḥ
5.045.023  sa tāñśarāṃstasya vimokṣayan kapiś̭ cacāra vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite
5.045.023 śarāntare mārutavadviniṣpataṋ manojavaḥ saṃyati caṇḍavikramaḥ
5.045.024  tamāttabāṇāsanamāhavonmukha̭ṃ khamāstṛṇantaṃ vividhaiḥ śarottamaiḥ
5.045.024 avaikṣatākṣaṃ bahumānacakṣuṣā̭ jagāma cintāṃ ca sa mārutātmajaḥ
5.045.025  tataḥ śarairbhinnabhujāntaraḥ kapi̭ḥ kumāravaryeṇa mahātmanā nadan
5.045.025 mahābhujaḥ karmaviśeṣatattvaviḓ vicintayāmāsa raṇe parākramam
5.045.026  abālavadbāladivākaraprabha̭ḥ karotyayaṃ karma mahanmahābalaḥ
5.045.026 na cāsya sarvāhavakarmaśobhina̭ḥ pramāpaṇe me matiratra jāyate
5.045.027  ayaṃ mahātmā ca mahāṃśca vīryata̭ḥ samāhitaścātisahaśca saṃyuge
5.045.027 asaṃśayaṃ karmaguṇodayādaya̭ṃ sanāgayakṣairmunibhiśca pūjitaḥ
5.045.028  parākramotsāhavivṛddhamānasa̭ḥ samīkṣate māṃ pramukhāgataḥ sthitaḥ
5.045.028 parākramo hyasya manāṃsi kampayeṱ surāsurāṇāmapi śīghrakāriṇaḥ
5.045.029  na khalvayaṃ nābhibhavedupekṣita̭ḥ parākramo hyasya raṇe vivardhate
5.045.029 pramāpaṇaṃ tveva mamāsya rocatḙ na vardhamāno'gnirupekṣituṃ kṣamaḥ
5.045.030  iti pravegaṃ tu parasya tarkayaṋ svakarmayogaṃ ca vidhāya vīryavān
5.045.030 cakāra vegaṃ tu mahābalastadā̭ matiṃ ca cakre'sya vadhe mahākapiḥ
5.045.031  sa tasya tānaṣṭahayānmahājavāṋ samāhitān bhārasahān vivartane
5.045.031 jaghāna vīraḥ pathi vāyusevitḙ talaprahālaiḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ
5.045.032  tatastalenābhihato mahāratha̭ḥ sa tasya piṅgādhipamantrinirjitaḥ
5.045.032 sa bhagnanīḍaḥ parimuktakūbara̭ḥ papāta bhūmau hatavājirambarāt
5.045.033  sa taṃ parityajya mahāratho ratha̭ṃ sakārmukaḥ khaḍgadharaḥ khamutpatat
5.045.033 tapo'bhiyogādṛṣirugravīryavāṋ vihāya dehaṃ marutāmivālayam
5.045.034  tataḥ kapistaṃ vicarantamambarḙ patatrirājānilasiddhasevite
5.045.034 sametya taṃ mārutavegavikrama̭ḥ krameṇa jagrāha ca pādayordṛḍham
5.045.035  sa taṃ samāvidhya sahasraśaḥ kapir̭ mahoragaṃ gṛhya ivāṇḍajeśvaraḥ
5.045.035 mumoca vegātpitṛtulyavikramo̭ mahītale saṃyati vānarottamaḥ
5.045.036  sa bhagnabāhūrukaṭīśiro dhara̭ḥ kṣarannasṛnnirmathitāsthilocanaḥ
5.045.036 sa bhinnasaṃdhiḥ pravikīrṇabandhano̭ hataḥ kṣitau vāyusutena rākṣasaḥ
5.045.037  mahākapirbhūmitale nipīḍya ta̭ṃ cakāra rakṣo'dhipatermahadbhayam
5.045.038  maharṣibhiścakracarairmahāvratai̭ḥ sametya bhūtaiśca sayakṣapannagaiḥ
5.045.038 suraiśca sendrairbhṛśajātavismayair̭ hate kumāre sa kapirnirīkṣitaḥ
5.045.039  nihatya taṃ vajrasutopamaprabha̭ṃ kumāramakṣaṃ kṣatajopamekṣaṇam
5.045.039 tadeva vīro'bhijagāma toraṇa̭ṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye
5.046.001  tatastu rakṣo'dhipatirmahātmā̭ hanūmatākṣe nihate kumāre
5.046.001 manaḥ samādhāya tadendrakalpa̭ṃ samādideśendrajitaṃ sa roṣāt
5.046.002  tvamastravicchastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha̭ḥ surāsurāṇāmapi śokadātā
5.046.002 sureṣu sendreṣu ca dṛṣṭakarmā̭ pitāmahārādhanasaṃcitāstraḥ
5.046.003  tavāstrabalamāsādya nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ
5.046.003 na kaścittriṣu lokeṣu saṃyuge na gataśramaḥ
5.046.004  bhujavīryābhiguptaśca tapasā cābhirakṣitaḥ
5.046.004 deśakālavibhāgajñastvameva matisattamaḥ
5.046.005  na te'styaśakyaṃ samareṣu karmaṇā̭ na te'styakāryaṃ matipūrvamantraṇe
5.046.005 na so'sti kaścittriṣu saṃgraheṣu vai̭ na veda yaste'strabalaṃ balaṃ ca te

6.042.036  dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ

6.043.001  dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
6.043.001 balādhyakṣamuvācedaṃ kṛtāñjalimupasthitam
6.043.002  śīghraṃ niryāntu durdharṣā rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ

6.043.003 niṣpetū rākṣasā mukhyā balādhyakṣapracoditāḥ
6.043.004  rathamāsthāya vipulaṃ taptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ

6.043.006  tasya nidhāvamānasya saṃrabdhasya yuyutsayā

6.043.009 tānutpātānacintyaiva nirjagāma raṇājiram

6.043.010 babhūva sumahānnādaḥ kṣobhayanniva sāgaram
6.043.011  tena śabdena vitrastā vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ
6.043.011 drumaśailapraharaṇā yoddhuṃ samavatiṣṭhata

6.043.012 rāmarāvaṇayorarthe samabhityaktajīvinām

6.043.014  teṣāṃ vinardātāṃ śabdaḥ saṃyuge'titarasvinām
6.043.014 śuśruve sumahān krodhādanyonyamabhigarjatām
6.043.015  rajaścāruṇavarṇābhaṃ subhīmamabhavadbhṛśam
6.043.015 uddhūtaṃ harirakṣobhiḥ saṃrurodha diśo daśa
6.043.016  anyonyaṃ rajasā tena kauśeyoddhūtapāṇḍunā

6.043.018  śabdaśca sumahāṃsteṣāṃ nardatāmabhidhāvatām
6.043.018 śrūyate tumule yuddhe na rūpāṇi cakāśire
6.043.019  harīneva susaṃkruddhā harayo jaghnurāhave
6.043.019 rākṣasāścāpi rakṣāṃsi nijaghnustimire tadā
6.043.020  parāṃścaiva vinighnantaḥ svāṃśca vānararākṣasāḥ
6.043.020 rudhirārdraṃ tadā cakrurmahīṃ paṅkānulepanām
6.043.021  tatastu rudhiraugheṇa siktaṃ vyapagataṃ rajaḥ
6.043.021 śarīraśavasaṃkīrṇā babhūva ca vasuṃdharā
6.043.022  drumaśaktiśilāprāsairgadāparighatomaraiḥ

6.043.023  bāhubhiḥ parighākārairyudhyantaḥ parvatopamāḥ

6.044.001  taddṛṣṭvā sumahatkarma kṛtaṃ vānarasattamaiḥ

6.044.010  vyavasthitaṃ hanūmantaṃ te dṛṣṭvā hariyūthapāḥ
6.044.010 babhūvurbalavanto hi balavantamupāśritāḥ
6.044.011  akampanastu śailābhaṃ hanūmantamavasthitam

6.044.015  ātmānaṃ tvapraharaṇaṃ jñātvā krodhasamanvitaḥ

6.044.020  so'śvakarṇaṃ samāsādya roṣadarpānvito hariḥ

6.045.001  akampanavadhaṃ śrutvā kruddho vai rākṣaseśvaraḥ
6.045.001 kiṃ ciddīnamukhaścāpi sacivāṃstānudaikṣata
6.045.002  sa tu dhyātvā muhūrtaṃ tu mantribhiḥ saṃvicārya ca

6.045.003  tāṃ rākṣasagaṇairguptāṃ gulmairbahubhirāvṛtām
6.045.003 dadarśa nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm
6.045.004  ruddhāṃ tu nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
6.045.004 uvācāmarṣitaḥ kāle prahastaṃ yuddhakovidam
6.045.005  purasyopaniviṣṭasya sahasā pīḍitasya ca

6.045.006  ahaṃ vā kumbhakarṇo vā tvaṃ vā senāpatirmama
6.045.006 indrajidvā nikumbho vā vaheyurbhāramīdṛśam

6.045.009  capalā hyavinītāśca calacittāśca vānarāḥ

6.045.010  vidrute ca bale tasmin rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha

6.045.014  pradānena tu sītāyāḥ śreyo vyavasitaṃ mayā

6.045.015  so'haṃ dānaiśca mānaiśca satataṃ pūjitastvayā

6.045.017  evamuktvā tu bhartāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ vāhinīpatiḥ
6.045.017 samānayata me śīghraṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahadbalam
6.045.018  madbāṇāśanivegena hatānāṃ tu raṇājire
6.045.018 adya tṛpyantu māṃsena pakṣiṇaḥ kānanaukasām
6.045.019  ityuktāste prahastena balādhyakṣāḥ kṛtatvarāḥ
6.045.019 balamudyojayāmāsustasmin rākṣasamandire
6.045.020  sā babhūva muhūrtena tigmanānāvidhāyudhaiḥ
6.045.020 laṅkā rākṣasavīraistairgajairiva samākulā

6.045.028  tato duṃdubhinirghoṣaḥ parjanyaninadopamaḥ

6.045.029  ninadantaḥ svarān ghorān rākṣasā jagmuragrataḥ
6.045.029 bhīmarūpā mahākāyāḥ prahastasya puraḥsarāḥ
6.045.030  vyūḍhenaiva sughoreṇa pūrvadvārātsa niryayau
6.045.030 gajayūthanikāśena balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
6.045.031  sāgarapratimaughena vṛtastena balena saḥ

6.045.032  tasya niryāṇa ghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṃ ca nardatām
6.045.032 laṅkāyāṃ sarvabhūtāni vinedurvikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ
6.045.033  vyabhramākāśamāviśya māṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ
6.045.033 maṇḍalānyapasavyāni khagāścakrū rathaṃ prati
6.045.034  vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghorā vavāśire
6.045.035  antarikṣātpapātolkā vāyuśca paruṣo vavau
6.045.035 anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhā grahāśca na cakāśire
6.045.036  vavarṣū rudhiraṃ cāsya siṣicuśca puraḥsarān

6.045.037  sāratherbahuśaścāsya saṃgrāmamavagāhataḥ
6.045.037 pratodo nyapataddhastātsūtasya hayasādinaḥ
6.045.038  niryāṇa śrīśca yāsyāsīdbhāsvarā ca sudurlabhā
6.045.038 sā nanāśa muhūrtena same ca skhalitā hayāḥ
6.045.039  prahastaṃ tvabhiniryāntaṃ prakhyāta balapauruṣam
6.045.039 yudhi nānāpraharaṇā kapisenābhyavartata

6.048.001  sa praviśya purīṃ laṅkāṃ rāmabāṇabhayārditaḥ
6.048.001 bhagnadarpastadā rājā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ
6.048.002  mātaṃga iva siṃhena garuḍeneva pannagaḥ

6.048.006  idaṃ tadbrahmaṇo ghoraṃ vākyaṃ māmabhyupasthitam

6.048.007  devadānavagandharvairyakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ

6.048.010  sa parājitamātmānaṃ prahastaṃ ca niṣūditam
6.048.010 jñātvā rakṣobalaṃ bhīmamādideśa mahābalaḥ
6.048.011  dvāreṣu yatnaḥ kriyatāṃ prākārāścādhiruhyatām
6.048.011 nidrāvaśasamāviṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām
6.048.012  nava ṣaṭsapta cāṣṭau ca māsān svapiti rākṣasaḥ
6.048.012 taṃ tu bodhayata kṣipraṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam
6.048.013  sa hi saṃkhye mahābāhuḥ kakudaṃ sarvarakṣasām
6.048.013 vānarān rājaputrau ca kṣiprameva vadhiṣyati
6.048.014  kumbhakarṇaḥ sadā śete mūḍho grāmyasukhe rataḥ
6.048.014 rāmeṇābhinirastasya saṃgrāmo'smin sudāruṇe
6.048.015  bhaviṣyati na me śokaḥ kumbhakarṇe vibodhite

6.048.016  īdṛśe vyasane prāpte yo na sāhyāya kalpate

6.048.017  jagmuḥ paramasaṃbhrāntāḥ kumbhakarṇaniveśanam
6.048.017 te rāvaṇasamādiṣṭā māṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ
6.048.018  gandhamālyāṃstathā bhakṣyānādāya sahasā yayuḥ
6.048.018 tāṃ praviśya mahādvārāṃ sarvato yojanāyatām
6.048.019  kumbhakarṇaguhāṃ ramyāṃ sarvagandhapravāhinīm
6.048.019 pratiṣṭhamānāḥ kṛcchreṇa yatnātpraviviśurguhām
6.048.020  tāṃ praviśya guhāṃ ramyāṃ śubhāṃ kāñcanakuṭṭimām
6.048.020 dadṛśurnairṛtavyāghraṃ śayānaṃ bhīmadarśanam
6.048.021  te tu taṃ vikṛtaṃ suptaṃ vikīrṇamiva parvatam
6.048.021 kumbhakarṇaṃ mahānidraṃ sahitāḥ pratyabodhayan
6.048.022  ūrdhvaromāñcitatanuṃ śvasantamiva pannagam

6.054.001  sa nanāda mahānādaṃ samudramabhinādayan

6.055.001  te nivṛttā mahākāyāḥ śrutvāṅgadavacastadā

6.055.050 jahāra sugrīvamabhipragṛhya̭ yathānilo meghamatipracaṇḍaḥ
6.055.051  sa taṃ mahāmeghanikāśarūpam̭ utpāṭya gacchan yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ
6.055.051 rarāja merupratimānarūpo̭ meruryathātyucchritaghoraśṛṅgaḥ
6.055.052  tataḥ samutpāṭya jagāma vīra̭ḥ saṃstūyamāno yudhi rākṣasendraiḥ
6.055.052 śṛṇvanninādaṃ tridaśālayānā̭ṃ plavaṃgarājagrahavismitānām
6.055.053  tatastamādāya tadā sa menḙ harīndramindropamamindravīryaḥ
6.055.053 asmin hṛte sarvamidaṃ hṛtaṃ syāṱ sarāghavaṃ sainyamitīndraśatruḥ
6.055.054  vidrutāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarāṇāṃ tatastataḥ
6.055.054 kumbhakarṇena sugrīvaṃ gṛhītaṃ cāpi vānaram
6.055.055  hanūmāṃścintayāmāsa matimānmārutātmajaḥ
6.055.055 evaṃ gṛhīte sugrīve kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā bhavet
6.055.056  yadvai nyāyyaṃ mayā kartuṃ tatkariṣyāmi sarvathā
6.055.056 bhūtvā parvatasaṃkāśo nāśayiṣyāmi rākṣasaṃ
6.055.057  mayā hate saṃyati kumbhakarṇḙ mahābale muṣṭiviśīrṇadehe
6.055.057 vimocite vānarapārthive ca̭ bhavantu hṛṣṭāḥ pravagāḥ samagrāḥ
6.055.058  atha vā svayamapyeṣa mokṣaṃ prāpsyati pārthivaḥ
6.055.058 gṛhīto'yaṃ yadi bhavettridaśaiḥ sāsuroragaiḥ
6.055.059  manye na tāvadātmānaṃ budhyate vānarādhipaḥ
6.055.059 śailaprahārābhihataḥ kumbhakarṇena saṃyuge
6.055.060  ayaṃ muhūrtātsugrīvo labdhasaṃjño mahāhave
6.055.060 ātmano vānarāṇāṃ ca yatpathyaṃ tatkariṣyati
6.055.061  mayā tu mokṣitasyāsya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
6.055.061 aprītaśca bhavetkaṣṭā kīrtināśaśca śāśvataḥ
6.055.062  tasmānmuhūrtaṃ kāṅkṣiṣye vikramaṃ pārthivasya naḥ
6.055.062 bhinnaṃ ca vānarānīkaṃ tāvadāśvāsayāmyaham
6.055.063  ityevaṃ cintayitvā tu hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
6.055.063 bhūyaḥ saṃstambhayāmāsa vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūm
6.055.064  sa kumbhakarṇo'tha viveśa laṅkā̭ṃ sphurantamādāya mahāhariṃ tam
6.055.064 vimānacaryāgṛhagopurasthai̭ḥ puṣpāgryavarṣairavakīryamāṇaḥ
6.055.065  tataḥ sa saṃjñāmupalabhya kṛcchrāḓ balīyasastasya bhujāntarasthaḥ
6.055.065 avekṣamāṇaḥ purarājamārga̭ṃ vicintayāmāsa muhurmahātmā
6.055.066  evaṃ gṛhītena kathaṃ nu nāma̭ śakyaṃ mayā saṃprati kartumadya
6.055.066 tathā kariṣyāmi yathā harīṇā̭ṃ bhaviṣyatīṣṭaṃ ca hitaṃ ca kāryam
6.055.067  tataḥ karāgraiḥ sahasā sametya̭ rājā harīṇāmamarendraśatroḥ
6.055.067 nakhaiśca karṇau daśanaiśca nāsā̭ṃ dadaṃśa pārśveṣu ca kumbhakarṇam
6.055.068  sa kumbhakarṇau hṛtakarṇanāso̭ vidāritastena vimarditaśca
6.055.068 roṣābhibhūtaḥ kṣatajārdragātra̭ḥ sugrīvamāvidhya pipeṣa bhūmau
6.055.069  sa bhūtale bhīmabalābhipiṣṭa̭ḥ surāribhistairabhihanyamānaḥ
6.055.069 jagāma khaṃ vegavadabhyupetya̭ punaśca rāmeṇa samājagāma
6.055.070  karṇanāsā vihīnasya kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ
6.055.070 rarāja śoṇitotsikto giriḥ prasravaṇairiva
6.055.071  tataḥ sa puryāḥ sahasā mahātmā̭ niṣkramya tadvānarasainyamugram
6.055.071 babhakṣa rakṣo yudhi kumbhakarṇa̭ḥ prajā yugāntāgniriva pradīptaḥ
6.055.072  bubhukṣitaḥ śoṇitamāṃsagṛdhnṷḥ praviśya tadvānarasainyamugram
6.055.072 cakhāda rakṣāṃsi harīn piśācāṋ ṛkṣāṃśca mohādyudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ
6.055.073  ekaṃ dvau trīn bahūn kruddho vānarān saha rākṣasaiḥ
6.055.073 samādāyaikahastena pracikṣepa tvaranmukhe
6.055.074  saṃprasravaṃstadā medaḥ śoṇitaṃ ca mahābalaḥ
6.055.074 vadhyamāno nagendrāgrairbhakṣayāmāsa vānarān
6.055.074  te bhakṣyamāṇā harayo rāmaṃ jagmustadā gatim
6.055.075  tasmin kāle sumitrāyāḥ putraḥ parabalārdanaḥ
6.055.075 cakāra lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddho yuddhaṃ parapuraṃjayaḥ
6.055.076  sa kumbhakarṇasya śarāñśarīre sapta vīryavān
6.055.076 nicakhānādade cānyān visasarja ca lakṣmaṇaḥ
6.055.077  atikramya ca saumitriṃ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ
6.055.077 rāmamevābhidudrāva dārayanniva medinīm
6.055.078  atha dāśarathī rāmo raudramastraṃ prayojayan
6.055.078 kumbhakarṇasya hṛdaye sasarja niśitāñśarān
6.055.079  tasya rāmeṇa viddhasya sahasābhipradhāvataḥ
6.055.079 aṅgāramiśrāḥ kruddhasya mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ
6.055.080  tasyorasi nimagnāśca śarā barhiṇavāsasaḥ
6.055.080 hastāccāsya paribhraṣṭā papātorvyāṃ mahāgadā
6.055.081  sa nirāyudhamātmānaṃ yadā mene mahābalaḥ
6.055.081 muṣṭibhyāṃ cāraṇābhyāṃ ca cakāra kadanaṃ mahat
6.055.082  sa bāṇairatividdhāṅgaḥ kṣatajena samukṣitaḥ
6.055.082 rudhiraṃ parisusrāva giriḥ prasravaṇāniva
6.055.083  sa tīvreṇa ca kopena rudhireṇa ca mūrchitaḥ
6.055.083 vānarān rākṣasānṛkṣān khādan viparidhāvati
6.055.084  tasmin kāle sa dharmātmā lakṣmaṇo rāmamabravīt
6.055.084 kumbhakarṇavadhe yukto yogān parimṛśan bahūn
6.055.085  naivāyaṃ vānarān rājanna vijānāti rākṣasān
6.055.085 mattaḥ śoṇitagandhena svān parāṃścaiva khādati
6.055.086  sādhvenamadhirohantu sarvato vānararṣabhāḥ
6.055.086 yūthapāśca yathāmukhyāstiṣṭhantvasya samantataḥ
6.055.087  apyayaṃ durmatiḥ kāle gurubhāraprapīḍitaḥ
6.055.087 prapatan rākṣaso bhūmau nānyān hanyātplavaṃgamān
6.055.088  tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājaputrasya dhīmataḥ
6.055.088 te samāruruhurhṛṣṭāḥ kumbhakarṇaṃ plavaṃgamāḥ
6.055.089  kumbhakarṇastu saṃkruddhaḥ samārūḍhaḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ
6.055.089 vyadhūnayattān vegena duṣṭahastīva hastipān
6.055.090  tān dṛṣṭvā nirdhūtān rāmo ruṣṭo'yamiti rākṣasaḥ
6.055.090 samutpapāta vegena dhanuruttamamādade
6.055.091  sa cāpamādāya bhujaṃgakalpa̭ṃ dṛḍhajyamugraṃ tapanīyacitram
6.055.091 harīn samāśvāsya samutpapāta̭ rāmo nibaddhottamatūṇabāṇaḥ
6.055.092  sa vānaragaṇaistaistu vṛtaḥ paramadurjayaḥ
6.055.092 lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ saṃpratasthe mahābalaḥ
6.055.093  sa dadarśa mahātmānaṃ kirīṭinamariṃdamam
6.055.093 śoṇitāplutasarvāṅgaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam
6.055.094  sarvān samabhidhāvantaṃ yathāruṣṭaṃ diśā gajam
6.055.094 mārgamāṇaṃ harīn kruddhaṃ rākṣasaiḥ parivāritam
6.055.095  vindhyamandarasaṃkāśaṃ kāñcanāṅgadabhūṣaṇam
6.055.095 sravantaṃ rudhiraṃ vaktrādvarṣameghamivotthitam
6.055.096  jihvayā parilihyantaṃ śoṇitaṃ śoṇitokṣitam
6.055.096 mṛdnantaṃ vānarānīkaṃ kālāntakayamopamam
6.055.097  taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ pradīptānalavarcasaṃ
6.055.097 visphārayāmāsa tadā kārmukaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
6.055.098  sa tasya cāpanirghoṣātkupito nairṛtarṣabhaḥ
6.055.098 amṛṣyamāṇastaṃ ghoṣamabhidudrāva rāghavam
6.055.099  tatastu vātoddhatameghakalpa̭ṃ bhujaṃgarājottamabhogabāhum
6.055.099 tamāpatantaṃ dharaṇīdharābham̭ uvāca rāmo yudhi kumbhakarṇam
6.055.100  āgaccha rakṣo'dhipamā viṣādam̭ avasthito'haṃ pragṛhītacāpaḥ
6.055.100 avehi māṃ śakrasapatna rāmam̭ ayaṃ muhūrtādbhavitā vicetāḥ
6.055.101  rāmo'yamiti vijñāya jahāsa vikṛtasvanam
6.055.101 pātayanniva sarveṣāṃ hṛdayāni vanaukasām
6.055.102  prahasya vikṛtaṃ bhīmaṃ sa meghasvanitopamam
6.055.102 kumbhakarṇo mahātejā rāghavaṃ vākyamabravīt
6.055.103  nāhaṃ virādho vijñeyo na kabandhaḥ kharo na ca
6.055.103 na vālī na ca mārīcaḥ kumbhakarṇo'hamāgataḥ
6.055.104  paśya me mudgaraṃ ghoraṃ sarvakālāyasaṃ mahat
6.055.104 anena nirjitā devā dānavāśca mayā purā
6.055.105  vikarṇanāsa iti māṃ nāvajñātuṃ tvamarhasi
6.055.105 svalpāpi hi na me pīḍā karṇanāsāvināśanāt
6.055.106  darśayekṣvākuśārdūla vīryaṃ gātreṣu me laghu
6.055.106 tatastvāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭapauruṣavikramam
6.055.107  sa kumbhakarṇasya vaco niśamya̭ rāmaḥ supuṅkhān visasarja bāṇān
6.055.107 tairāhato vajrasamapravegair̭ na cukṣubhe na vyathate surāriḥ
6.055.108  yaiḥ sāyakaiḥ sālavarā nikṛttā̭ vālī hato vānarapuṃgavaśca
6.055.108 te kumbhakarṇasya tadā śarīra̭ṃ vajropamā na vyathayāṃ pracakruḥ
6.055.109  sa vāridhārā iva sāyakāṃstāṋ pibañśarīreṇa mahendraśatruḥ
6.055.109 jaghāna rāmasya śarapravega̭ṃ vyāvidhya taṃ mudgaramugravegam
6.055.110  tatastu rakṣaḥ kṣatajānulipta̭ṃ vitrāsanaṃ devamahācamūnām
6.055.110 vyāvidhya taṃ mudgaramugravega̭ṃ vidrāvayāmāsa camūṃ harīṇām
6.055.111  vāyavyamādāya tato varāstra̭ṃ rāmaḥ pracikṣepa niśācarāya
6.055.111 samudgaraṃ tena jahāra bāhṷṃ sa kṛttabāhustumulaṃ nanāda
6.055.112  sa tasya bāhurgiriśṛṅgakalpa̭ḥ samudgaro rāghavabāṇakṛttaḥ
6.055.112 papāta tasmin harirājasainyḙ jaghāna tāṃ vānaravāhinīṃ ca
6.055.113  te vānarā bhagnahatāvaśeṣā̭ḥ paryantamāśritya tadā viṣaṇṇāḥ
6.055.113 pravepitāṅgā dadṛśuḥ sughora̭ṃ narendrarakṣo'dhipasaṃnipātam
6.055.114  sa kumbhakarṇo'stranikṛttabāhur̭ mahānnikṛttāgra ivācalendraḥ
6.055.114 utpāṭayāmāsa kareṇa vṛkṣa̭ṃ tato'bhidudrāva raṇe narendram
6.055.115  taṃ tasya bāhuṃ saha sālavṛkṣa̭ṃ samudyataṃ pannagabhogakalpam
6.055.115 aindrāstrayuktena jahāra rāmo̭ bāṇena jāmbūnadacitritena
6.055.116  sa kumbhakarṇasya bhujo nikṛtta̭ḥ papāta bhūmau girisaṃnikāśaḥ
6.055.116 viveṣṭamāno nijaghāna vṛkṣāṋ̃ śailāñśilāvānararākṣasāṃśca
6.055.117  taṃ chinnabāhuṃ samavekṣya rāma̭ḥ samāpatantaṃ sahasā nadantam
6.055.117 dvāvardhacandrau niśitau pragṛhya̭ ciccheda pādau yudhi rākṣasasya
6.055.118  nikṛttabāhurvinikṛttapādo̭ vidārya vaktraṃ vaḍavāmukhābham
6.055.118 dudrāva rāmaṃ sahasābhigarjaṋ rāhuryathā candramivāntarikṣe
6.055.119  apūrayattasya mukhaṃ śitāgrai̭ rāmaḥ śarairhemapinaddhapuṅkhaiḥ
6.055.119 sa pūrṇavaktro na śaśāka vaktṷṃ cukūja kṛcchreṇa mumoha cāpi
6.055.120  athādade sūryamarīcikalpa̭ṃ sa brahmadaṇḍāntakakālakalpam
6.055.120 ariṣṭamaindraṃ niśitaṃ supuṅkha̭ṃ rāmaḥ śaraṃ mārutatulyavegam
6.055.121  taṃ vajrajāmbūnadacārupuṅkha̭ṃ pradīptasūryajvalanaprakāśam
6.055.121 mahendravajrāśanitulyavega̭ṃ rāmaḥ pracikṣepa niśācarāya
6.055.122  sa sāyako rāghavabāhucodito̭ diśaḥ svabhāsā daśa saṃprakāśayan
6.055.122 vidhūmavaiśvānaradīptadarśano̭ jagāma śakrāśanitulyavikramaḥ
6.055.123  sa tanmahāparvatakūṭasaṃnibha̭ṃ vivṛttadaṃṣṭraṃ calacārukuṇḍalam
6.055.123 cakarta rakṣo'dhipateḥ śirastadā̭ yathaiva vṛtrasya purā puraṃdaraḥ
6.055.124  tadrāmabāṇābhihataṃ papāta̭ rakṣaḥśiraḥ parvatasaṃnikāśam
6.055.124 babhañja caryāgṛhagopurāṇi̭ prākāramuccaṃ tamapātayacca
6.055.125  taccātikāyaṃ himavatprakāśa̭ṃ rakṣastadā toyanidhau papāta
6.055.125 grāhānmahāmīnacayān bhujaṃgamāṋ mamarda bhūmiṃ ca tathā viveśa
6.055.126  tasmirhate brāhmaṇadevaśatraṷ mahābale saṃyati kumbhakarṇe
6.055.126 cacāla bhūrbhūmidharāśca sarvḙ harṣācca devāstumulaṃ praṇeduḥ
6.055.127  tatastu devarṣimaharṣipannagā̭ḥ surāśca bhūtāni suparṇaguhyakāḥ
6.055.127 sayakṣagandharvagaṇā nabhogatā̭ḥ praharṣitā rāma parākrameṇa
6.055.128  praharṣamīyurbahavastu vānarā̭ḥ prabuddhapadmapratimairivānanaiḥ
6.055.128 apūjayan rāghavamiṣṭabhāgina̭ṃ hate ripau bhīmabale durāsade
6.055.129  sa kumbhakarṇaṃ surasainyamardana̭ṃ mahatsu yuddheṣvaparājitaśramam
6.055.129 nananda hatvā bharatāgrajo raṇḙ mahāsuraṃ vṛtramivāmarādhipaḥ
6.056.001  kumbhakarṇaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
6.056.001 rākṣasā rākṣasendrāya rāvaṇāya nyavedayan
6.056.002  śrutvā vinihataṃ saṃkhye kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam
6.056.002 rāvaṇaḥ śokasaṃtapto mumoha ca papāta ca
6.056.003  pitṛvyaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā devāntakanarāntakau
6.056.003 triśirāścātikāyaśca ruruduḥ śokapīḍitāḥ
6.056.004  bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
6.056.004 mahodaramahāpārśvau śokākrāntau babhūvatuḥ
6.056.005  tataḥ kṛcchrātsamāsādya saṃjñāṃ rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ
6.056.005 kumbhakarṇavadhāddīno vilalāpa sa rāvaṇaḥ
6.056.006  hā vīra ripudarpaghna kumbhakarṇa mahābala
6.056.006 śatrusainyaṃ pratāpyaikaḥ kva māṃ saṃtyajya gacchasi
6.056.007  idānīṃ khalvahaṃ nāsmi yasya me patito bhujaḥ
6.056.007 dakṣiṇo yaṃ samāśritya na bibhemi surāsurān
6.056.008  kathamevaṃvidho vīro devadānavadarpahā
6.056.008 kālāgnipratimo hyadya rāghaveṇa raṇe hataḥ
6.056.009  yasya te vajraniṣpeṣo na kuryādvyasanaṃ sadā
6.056.009 sa kathaṃ rāmabāṇārtaḥ prasupto'si mahītale
6.056.010  ete devagaṇāḥ sārdhamṛṣibhirgagane sthitāḥ
6.056.010 nihataṃ tvāṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā ninadanti praharṣitāḥ
6.056.011  dhruvamadyaiva saṃhṛṣṭā labdhalakṣyāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ
6.056.011 ārokṣyantīha durgāṇi laṅkādvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ
6.056.012  rājyena nāsti me kāryaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi sītayā
6.056.012 kumbhakarṇavihīnasya jīvite nāsti me ratiḥ
6.056.013  yadyahaṃ bhrātṛhantāraṃ na hanmi yudhi rāghavam
6.056.013 nanu me maraṇaṃ śreyo na cedaṃ vyarthajīvitam
6.056.014  adyaiva taṃ gamiṣyāmi deśaṃ yatrānujo mama
6.056.014 na hi bhrātṝn samutsṛjya kṣaṇaṃ jīvitumutsahe
6.056.015  devā hi māṃ hasiṣyanti dṛṣṭvā pūrvāpakāriṇam
6.056.015 kathamindraṃ jayiṣyāmi kumbhakarṇahate tvayi
6.056.016  tadidaṃ māmanuprāptaṃ vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śubham
6.056.016 yadajñānānmayā tasya na gṛhītaṃ mahātmanaḥ
6.056.017  vibhīṣaṇavaco yāvatkumbhakarṇaprahastayoḥ
6.056.017 vināśo'yaṃ samutpanno māṃ vrīḍayati dāruṇaḥ
6.056.018  tasyāyaṃ karmaṇaḥ prāto vipāko mama śokadaḥ
6.056.018 yanmayā dhārmikaḥ śrīmān sa nirasto vibhīṣaṇaḥ
6.056.019  iti bahuvidhamākulāntarātmā̭ kṛpaṇamatīva vilapya kumbhakarṇam
6.056.019 nyapatadatha daśānano bhṛśārtas̭ tamanujamindraripuṃ hataṃ viditvā
6.057.001  evaṃ vilapamānasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
6.057.001 śrutvā śokābhitaptasya triśirā vākyamabravīt
6.057.002  evameva mahāvīryo hato nastāta madhyamaḥ
6.057.002 na tu satpuruṣā rājan vilapanti yathā bhavān
6.057.003  nūnaṃ tribhuvaṇasyāpi paryāptastvamasi prabho
6.057.003 sa kasmātprākṛta iva śokasyātmānamīdṛśam
6.057.004  brahmadattāsti te śaktiḥ kavacaḥ sāyako dhanuḥ
6.057.004 sahasrakharasaṃyukto ratho meghasamasvanaḥ
6.057.005  tvayāsakṛdviśastreṇa viśastā devadānavāḥ
6.057.005 sa sarvāyudhasaṃpanno rāghavaṃ śāstumarhasi
6.057.006  kāmaṃ tiṣṭha mahārājanirgamiṣyāmyahaṃ raṇam
6.057.006 uddhariṣyāmi te śatrūn garuḍaḥ pannagāniha
6.057.007  śambaro devarājena narako viṣṇunā yathā
6.057.007 tathādya śayitā rāmo mayā yudhi nipātitaḥ
6.057.008  śrutvā triśiraso vākyaṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
6.057.008 punarjātamivātmānaṃ manyate kālacoditaḥ

6.057.041  nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ samudyatamahāyudham
6.057.041 dīptānalaraviprakhyairnairṛtaiḥ sarvato vṛtam

6.057.055  chinnavarmatanutrāṇā rākṣasā vānarairhatāḥ
6.057.055 rudhiraṃ prasrutāstatra rasasāramiva drumāḥ
6.057.056  rathena ca rathaṃ cāpi vāraṇena ca vāraṇam

6.058.001  narāntakaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā cukruśurnairṛtarṣabhāḥ

6.060.001  tato hatān rākṣasapuṃgavāṃstāṋ devāntakāditriśiro'tikāyān

6.090.001  lakṣmaṇena tu tadvākyamuktaṃ śrutvā sa rāghavaḥ

6.101.011  tadāśvasihi viśvastā svagṛhe parivartase

6.101.012  evamuktā samutpatya sītā śaśinibhānanā
6.101.012 praharṣeṇāvaruddhā sā vyājahāra na kiṃ cana
6.101.013  abravīcca hariśreṣṭhaḥ sītāmapratijalpatīm
6.101.013 kiṃ tvaṃ cintayase devi kiṃ ca māṃ nābhibhāṣase
6.101.014  evamuktā hanumatā sītā dharme vyavasthitā

6.101.016  na hi paśyāmi sadṛśaṃ cintayantī plavaṃgama
6.101.016 matpriyākhyānakasyeha tava pratyabhinandanam

6.101.017 sadṛśaṃ matpriyākhyāne tava dātuṃ bhavetsamam
6.101.018  hiraṇyaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ vā ratnāni vividhāni ca

6.101.019  evamuktastu vaidehyā pratyuvāca plavaṃgamaḥ
6.101.019 pragṛhītāñjalirvākyaṃ sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ
6.101.020  bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇi
6.101.020 snigdhamevaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum
6.101.021  tavaitadvacanaṃ saumye sāravatsnigdhameva ca

6.101.023  imāstu khalu rākṣasyo yadi tvamanumanyase
6.101.023 hantumicchāmyahaṃ sarvā yābhistvaṃ tarjitā purā
6.101.024  kliśyantīṃ patidevāṃ tvāmaśokavanikāṃ gatām
6.101.024 ghorarūpasamācārāḥ krūrāḥ krūratarekṣaṇāḥ
6.101.025  rākṣasyo dāruṇakathā varametaṃ prayaccha me
6.101.025 icchāmi vividhairghātairhantumetāḥ sudāruṇāḥ
6.101.026  muṣṭibhiḥ pāṇibhiścaiva caraṇaiścaiva śobhane
6.101.026 ghorairjānuprahāraiśca daśanānāṃ ca pātanaiḥ
6.101.027  bhakṣaṇaiḥ karṇanāsānāṃ keśānāṃ luñcanaistathā
6.101.027 bhṛśaṃ śuṣkamukhībhiśca dāruṇairlaṅghanairhataiḥ
6.101.028  evaṃprakārairbahubhirviprakārairyaśasvini
6.101.028 hantumicchāmyahaṃ devi tavemāḥ kṛtakilbiṣāḥ
6.101.029  evamuktā mahumatā vaidehī janakātmajā
6.101.029 uvāca dharmasahitaṃ hanūmantaṃ yaśasvinī
6.101.030  rājasaṃśrayavaśyānāṃ kurvatīnāṃ parājñayā
6.101.030 vidheyānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ kaḥ kupyedvānarottama
6.101.031  bhāgyavaiṣamya yogena purā duścaritena ca
6.101.031 mayaitetprāpyate sarvaṃ svakṛtaṃ hyupabhujyate
6.101.032  prāptavyaṃ tu daśā yogānmayaitaditi niścitam
6.101.032 dāsīnāṃ rāvaṇasyāhaṃ marṣayāmīha durbalā
6.101.033  ājñaptā rāvaṇenaitā rākṣasyo māmatarjayan
6.101.033 hate tasminna kuryurhi tarjanaṃ vānarottama
6.101.034  ayaṃ vyāghrasamīpe tu purāṇo dharmasaṃhitaḥ
6.101.034 ṛkṣeṇa gītaḥ śloko me taṃ nibodha plavaṃgama
6.101.035  na paraḥ pāpamādatte pareṣāṃ pāpakarmaṇām
6.101.035 samayo rakṣitavyastu santaścāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ
6.101.036  pāpānāṃ vā śubhānāṃ vā vadhārhāṇāṃ plavaṃgama
6.101.036 kāryaṃ kāruṇyamāryeṇa na kaścinnāparādhyati
6.101.037  lokahiṃsāvihārāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpiṇam
6.101.037 kurvatāmapi pāpāni naiva kāryamaśobhanam
6.101.038  evamuktastu hanumān sītayā vākyakovidaḥ
6.101.038 pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṃ rāmapatnīṃ yaśasvinīm
6.101.039  yuktā rāmasya bhavatī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī
6.101.039 pratisaṃdiśa māṃ devi gamiṣye yatra rāghavaḥ
6.101.040  evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā
6.101.040 abravīddraṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṃ vānarottama
6.101.041  tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā hanumān pavanātmajaḥ
6.101.041 harṣayanmaithilīṃ vākyamuvācedaṃ mahādyutiḥ
6.101.042  pūrṇacandrānanaṃ rāmaṃ drakṣyasyārye salakṣmaṇam
6.101.042 sthiramitraṃ hatāmitraṃ śacīva tridaśeśvaram
6.101.043  tāmevamuktvā rājantīṃ sītāṃ sākṣādiva śriyam
6.101.043 ājagāma mahāvego hanūmān yatra rāghavaḥ
6.102.001  sa uvāca mahāprajñamabhigamya plavaṃgamaḥ
6.102.001 rāmaṃ vacanamarthajño varaṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām
6.102.002  yannimitto'yamārambhaḥ karmaṇāṃ ca phalodayaḥ
6.102.002 tāṃ devīṃ śokasaṃtaptāṃ maithilīṃ draṣṭumarhasi
6.102.003  sā hi śokasamāviṣṭā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā
6.102.003 maithilī vijayaṃ śrutvā tava harṣamupāgamat
6.102.004  pūrvakātpratyayāccāhamukto viśvastayā tayā
6.102.004 bhartāraṃ draṣṭumicchāmi kṛtārthaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam
6.102.005  evamukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
6.102.005 agacchatsahasā dhyānamāsīdbāṣpapariplutaḥ
6.102.006  dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niśvasya medinīmavalokayan
6.102.006 uvāca meghasaṃkāśaṃ vibhīṣaṇamupasthitam
6.102.007  divyāṅgarāgāṃ vaidehīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām
6.102.007 iha sītāṃ śiraḥsnātāmupasthāpaya māciram
6.102.008  evamuktastu rāmeṇa tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
6.102.008 praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ sītāṃ strībhiḥ svābhiracodayat
6.102.009  divyāṅgarāgā vaidehī divyābharaṇabhūṣitā
6.102.009 yānamāroha bhadraṃ te bhartā tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati
6.102.010  evamuktā tu vaidehī pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam
6.102.010 asnātā draṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṃ rākṣasādhipa
6.102.011  tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
6.102.011 yathāhaṃ rāmo bhartā te tattathā kartumarhasi
6.102.012  tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maithilī bhrātṛdevatā
6.102.012 bhartṛbhaktivratā sādhvī tatheti pratyabhāṣata
6.102.013  tataḥ sītāṃ śiraḥsnātāṃ yuvatībhiralaṃkṛtām
6.102.013 mahārhābharaṇopetāṃ mahārhāmbaradhāriṇīm
6.102.014  āropya śibikāṃ dīptāṃ parārdhyāmbarasaṃvṛtām
6.102.014 rakṣobhirbahubhirguptāmājahāra vibhīṣaṇaḥ
6.102.015  so'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ jñātvābhidhyānamāsthitam
6.102.015 praṇataśca prahṛṣṭaśca prāptāṃ sītāṃ nyavedayat
6.102.016  tāmāgatāmupaśrutya rakṣogṛhaciroṣitām
6.102.016 harṣo dainyaṃ ca roṣaśca trayaṃ rāghavamāviśat
6.102.017  tataḥ pārśvagataṃ dṛṣṭvā savimarśaṃ vicārayan
6.102.017 vibhīṣaṇamidaṃ vākyamahṛṣṭo rāghavo'bravīt
6.102.018  rākṣasādhipate saumya nityaṃ madvijaye rata
6.102.018 vaidehī saṃnikarṣaṃ me śīghraṃ samupagacchatu
6.102.019  sa tadvacanamājñāya rāghavasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ
6.102.019 tūrṇamutsāraṇe yatnaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ
6.102.020  kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇastatra vetrajharjharapāṇayaḥ
6.102.020 utsārayantaḥ puruṣāḥ samantātparicakramuḥ
6.102.021  ṛkṣāṇāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ ca sarvataḥ
6.102.021 vṛndānyutsāryamāṇāni dūramutsasṛjustataḥ
6.102.022  teṣāmutsāryamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dhvanirutthitaḥ
6.102.022 vāyunodvartamānasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
6.102.023  utsāryamāṇāṃstān dṛṣṭvā samantājjātasaṃbhramān
6.102.023 dākṣiṇyāttadamarṣācca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
6.102.024  saṃrabdhaścābravīdrāmaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva
6.102.024 vibhīṣaṇaṃ mahāprājñaṃ sopālambhamidaṃ vacaḥ
6.102.025  kimarthaṃ māmanādṛtya kṛśyate'yaṃ tvayā janaḥ
6.102.025 nivartayainamudyogaṃ jano'yaṃ svajano mama
6.102.026  na gṛhāṇi na vastrāṇi na prākārāstiraskriyāḥ
6.102.026 nedṛśā rājasatkārā vṛttamāvaraṇaṃ striyaḥ
6.102.027  vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddhe na svayaṃ vare
6.102.027 na kratau no vivāhe ca darśanaṃ duṣyate striyaḥ
6.102.028  saiṣā yuddhagatā caiva kṛcchre mahati ca sthitā
6.102.028 darśane'syā na doṣaḥ syānmatsamīpe viśeṣataḥ
6.102.029  tadānaya samīpaṃ me śīghramenāṃ vibhīṣaṇa

6.102.030 rāmasyopānayatsītāṃ saṃnikarṣaṃ vinītavat
6.102.031  tato lakṣmaṇasugrīvau hanūmāṃśca plavaṃgamaḥ
6.102.031 niśamya vākyaṃ rāmasya babhūvurvyathitā bhṛśam
6.102.032  kalatranirapekṣaiśca iṅgitairasya dāruṇaiḥ

6.103.001  tāṃ tu pārśve sthitāṃ prahvāṃ rāmaḥ saṃprekṣya maithilīm
6.103.001 hṛdayāntargatakrodho vyāhartumupacakrame
6.103.002  eṣāsi nirjitā bhadre śatruṃ jitvā mayā raṇe

6.103.003  gato'smyantamamarṣasya dharṣaṇā saṃpramārjitā
6.103.003 avamānaśca śatruśca mayā yugapaduddhṛtau
6.103.004  adya me pauruṣaṃ dṛṣṭamadya me saphalaḥ śramaḥ
6.103.004 adya tīrṇapratijñatvātprabhavāmīha cātmanaḥ
6.103.005  yā tvaṃ virahitā nītā calacittena rakṣasā
6.103.005 daivasaṃpādito doṣo mānuṣeṇa mayā jitaḥ
6.103.006  saṃprāptamavamānaṃ yastejasā na pramārjati
6.103.006 kastasya puruṣārtho'sti puruṣasyālpatejasaḥ
6.103.007  laṅghanaṃ ca samudrasya laṅkāyāścāvamardanam
6.103.007 saphalaṃ tasya tacchlāghyamadya karma hanūmataḥ
6.103.008  yuddhe vikramataścaiva hitaṃ mantrayataśca me
6.103.008 sugrīvasya sasainyasya saphalo'dya pariśramaḥ
6.103.009  nirguṇaṃ bhrātaraṃ tyaktvā yo māṃ svayamupasthitaḥ
6.103.009 vibhīṣaṇasya bhaktasya saphalo'dya pariśramaḥ
6.103.010  ityevaṃ bruvatastasya sītā rāmasya tadvacaḥ
6.103.010 mṛgīvotphullanayanā babhūvāśrupariplutā
6.103.011  paśyatastāṃ tu rāmasya bhūyaḥ krodho'bhyavartata
6.103.011 prabhūtājyāvasiktasya pāvakasyeva dīpyataḥ
6.103.012  sa baddhvā bhrukuṭiṃ vaktre tiryakprekṣitalocanaḥ
6.103.012 abravītparuṣaṃ sītāṃ madhye vānararakṣasām
6.103.013  yatkartavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa dharṣaṇāṃ parimārjatā
6.103.013 tatkṛtaṃ sakalaṃ sīte śatruhastādamarṣaṇāt
6.103.014  nirjitā jīvalokasya tapasā bhāvitātmanā
6.103.014 agastyena durādharṣā muninā dakṣiṇeva dik
6.103.015  viditaścāstu bhadraṃ te yo'yaṃ raṇapariśramaḥ
6.103.015 sa tīrṇaḥ suhṛdāṃ vīryānna tvadarthaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ
6.103.016  rakṣatā tu mayā vṛttamapavādaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
6.103.016 prakhyātasyātmavaṃśasya nyaṅgaṃ ca parimārjatā
6.103.017  prāptacāritrasaṃdehā mama pratimukhe sthitā
6.103.017 dīpo netrāturasyeva pratikūlāsi me dṛḍham
6.103.018  tadgaccha hyabhyanujñātā yateṣṭaṃ janakātmaje
6.103.018 etā daśa diśo bhadre kāryamasti na me tvayā
6.103.019  kaḥ pumān hi kule jātaḥ striyaṃ paragṛhoṣitām
6.103.019 tejasvi punarādadyātsuhṛllekhena cetasā
6.103.020  rāvaṇāṅkaparibhraṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭāṃ duṣṭena cakṣuṣā
6.103.020 kathaṃ tvāṃ punarādadyāṃ kulaṃ vyapadiśanmahat
6.103.021  tadarthaṃ nirjitā me tvaṃ yaśaḥ pratyāhṛtaṃ mayā
6.103.021 nāsti me tvayyabhiṣvaṅgo yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāmitaḥ
6.103.022  iti pravyāhṛtaṃ bhadre mayaitatkṛtabuddhinā
6.103.022 lakṣmaṇe bharate vā tvaṃ kuru buddhiṃ yathāsukham
6.103.023  sugrīve vānarendre vā rākṣasendre vibhīṣaṇe
6.103.023 niveśaya manaḥ śīte yathā vā sukhamātmanaḥ
6.103.024  na hi tvāṃ rāvaṇo dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāṃ manoramām
6.103.024 marṣayate ciraṃ sīte svagṛhe parivartinīm
6.103.025  tataḥ priyārhaśvaraṇā tadapriya̭ṃ priyādupaśrutya cirasya maithilī
6.103.025 mumoca bāṣpaṃ subhṛśaṃ pravepitā̭ gajendrahastābhihateva vallarī
6.104.001  evamuktā tu vaidehī paruṣaṃ lomaharṣaṇam

6.104.002  sā tadaśrutapūrvaṃ hi jane mahati maithilī

6.104.003  praviśantīva gātrāṇi svānyeva janakātmajā

6.104.006  na tathāsmi mahābāho yathā tvamavagacchasi
6.104.006 pratyayaṃ gaccha me svena cāritreṇaiva te śape

6.104.008  yadyahaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ gatāsmi vivaśā prabho
6.104.008 kāmakāro na me tatra daivaṃ tatrāparādhyati
6.104.009  madadhīnaṃ tu yattanme hṛdayaṃ tvayi vartate
6.104.009 parādhīneṣu gātreṣu kiṃ kariṣyāmyanīśvarā
6.104.010  sahasaṃvṛddhabhāvācca saṃsargeṇa ca mānada
6.104.010 yadyahaṃ te na vijñātā hatā tenāsmi śāśvatam
6.104.011  preṣitaste yadā vīro hanūmānavalokakaḥ
6.104.011 laṅkāsthāhaṃ tvayā vīra kiṃ tadā na visarjitā
6.104.012  pratyakṣaṃ vānarendrasya tvadvākyasamanantaram
6.104.012 tvayā saṃtyaktayā vīra tyaktaṃ syājjīvitaṃ mayā
6.104.013  na vṛthā te śramo'yaṃ syātsaṃśaye nyasya jīvitam
6.104.013 suhṛjjanaparikleśo na cāyaṃ niṣphalastava
6.104.014  tvayā tu naraśārdūla krodhamevānuvartatā
6.104.014 laghuneva manuṣyeṇa strītvameva puraskṛtam
6.104.015  apadeśena janakānnotpattirvasudhātalāt
6.104.015 mama vṛttaṃ ca vṛttajña bahu te na puraskṛtam
6.104.016  na pramāṇīkṛtaḥ pāṇirbālye bālena pīḍitaḥ
6.104.016 mama bhaktiśca śīlaṃ ca sarvaṃ te pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtam
6.104.017  evaṃ bruvāṇā rudatī bāṣpagadgadabhāṣiṇī
6.104.017 abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ sītā dīnaṃ dhyānaparaṃ sthitam
6.104.018  citāṃ me kuru saumitre vyasanasyāsya bheṣajam
6.104.018 mithyāpavādopahatā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe
6.104.019  aprītasya guṇairbhartustyaktayā janasaṃsadi
6.104.019 yā kṣamā me gatirgantuṃ pravekṣye havyavāhanam
6.104.020  evamuktastu vaidehyā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
6.104.020 amarṣavaśamāpanno rāghavānanamaikṣata
6.104.021  sa vijñāya manaśchandaṃ rāmasyākārasūcitam
6.104.021 citāṃ cakāra saumitrirmate rāmasya vīryavān
6.104.022  adhomukhaṃ tato rāmaṃ śanaiḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam
6.104.022 upāsarpata vaidehī dīpyamānaṃ hutāśanam

7.023.001  sa tu jitvā daśagrīvo yamaṃ tridaśapuṃgavam

7.023.002  jayena vardhayitvā ca mārīcapramukhāstataḥ

7.023.003  tato rasātalaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ praviṣṭaḥ payaso nidhim
7.023.003 daityoraga gaṇādhyuṣṭaṃ varuṇena surakṣitam
7.023.004  sa tu bhogavatīṃ gatvā purīṃ vāsukipālitām
7.023.004 sthāpya nāgān vaśe kṛtvā yayau maṇimatīṃ purīm
7.023.005  nivātakavacāstatra daityā labdhavarā vasan
7.023.005 rākṣasastān samāsādya yuddhena samupāhvayat
7.023.006  te tu sarve suvikrāntā daiteyā balaśālinaḥ
7.023.006 nānāpraharaṇāstatra prayuddhā yuddhadurmadāḥ
7.023.007  teṣāṃ tu yudhyamānānāṃ sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro gataḥ

7.023.013  arcitastairyathānyāyaṃ saṃvatsarasukhoṣitaḥ

7.023.014 salilendrapurānveṣī sa babhrāma rasātalam

7.023.017  kṣarantīṃ ca payo nityaṃ surabhiṃ gāmavasthitām
7.023.017 yasyāḥ payoviniṣyandātkṣīrodo nāma sāgaraḥ

7.023.018  amṛtaṃ yatra cotpannaṃ surā cāpi surāśinām

7.023.019 pradakṣiṇaṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ paramādbhutām
7.023.019  praviveśa mahāghoraṃ guptaṃ bahuvidhairbalaiḥ
7.023.020  tato dhārāśatākīrṇaṃ śāradābhranibhaṃ tadā

7.023.021  tato hatvā balādhyakṣān samare taiśca tāḍitaḥ
7.023.021 abravītkva gato yo vo rājā śīghraṃ nivedyatām

7.023.025  tato yuddhaṃ samabhavaddāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
7.023.025 salilendrasya putrāṇāṃ rāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ
7.023.026  amātyaistu mahāvīryairdaśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ

7.023.029 ākāśayuddhaṃ tumulaṃ devadānavayoriva

7.023.033 mumocāśu mahānādaṃ virathān prekṣya tān sthitān
7.023.034  te tu teṣāṃ rathāḥ sāśvāḥ saha sārathibhirvaraiḥ

7.023.036  dhanūṃṣi kṛtvā sajyāni vinirbhidya mahodaram
7.023.036 rāvaṇaṃ samare kruddhāḥ sahitāḥ samabhidravan
7.023.037  tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ kālāgniriva viṣṭhitaḥ

7.023.039  atha viddhāstu te vīrā viniṣpetuḥ padātayaḥ
7.023.040  tato rakṣo mahānādaṃ muktvā hanti sma vāruṇān

7.023.042  tānabravīttato rakṣo varuṇāya nivedyatām

7.023.043  gataḥ khalu mahātejā brahmalokaṃ jaleśvaraḥ

7.023.045 harṣānnādaṃ vimuñcan vai niṣkrānto varuṇālayāt
7.023.046  āgatastu pathā yena tenaiva vinivṛtya saḥ

7.024.001  nivartamānaḥ saṃhṛṣṭo rāvaṇaḥ sa durātmavān
7.024.001 jahre pathi narendrarṣidevagandharvakanyakāḥ

7.024.008  kathaṃ nu khalu me putraḥ kariṣyati mayā vinā

7.024.012  yaddurbalā balavatā bāndhavā rāvaṇena me

7.024.017 praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ

7.024.028  asmin kāle tu yatprāptaṃ tatkariṣyāmi te hitam

7.025.001  sa tu dattvā daśagrīvo vanaṃ ghoraṃ kharasya tat
